children: A layer of current land use still carried plans that no longer apply.
Four secondary plan names in the City's land use layer begin with "Retired -", across 1,056 polygons. Another 45 polygons have no plan name at all.
Retired plans are left out of current designations, and kept for history. Names are normalised for case before grouping.
